# Flow (theflow-ai.com)

> Flow is a cognitive workflow engine for organizations with sensitive data. It watches for what happened (a deal closes, a contract is signed, a case is approved), proposes the update across your files and stack, and writes it when a person approves. Sensitive data is masked before processing and high-risk steps wait for human approval.

Flow is an independent company. It is not affiliated with Google Flow, flow-ai.com (Aiven) or "The Flow" (Avi Sela).

## Founders
- Sali Sapan, CEO and Co-Founder. Attorney at Fischer Behar Chen; LL.B. and B.A. (Reichman University); M.Sc. in Data Science and Machine Learning (Bar-Ilan University).
- Tomer Steinmetz, CTO and Co-Founder. B.Sc. in Computer Science (Reichman University); AI Engineer at Amazon; previously Team Lead at Hypernative.

## Products
- Flow: for organizations with sensitive data. Scoped per engagement. Pricing: https://theflow-ai.com/pricing.html
- Glance: a Chrome extension for individuals, free to start, that stays on what you asked for or promised until it is really closed, and turns an email into one calendar event, task or drafted reply in one click (it never sends). For general business use, not for regulated or sensitive data. A separate product from Flow. https://theflow-ai.com/trial.html
